blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Two bettors hit the P390.36-million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draw held on Saturday, Nov. 21, 2026. The winning numbers were 21-04-29-08-26-09, earning the two winners a combined jackpot prize of P390,356,981.96, which they will split equally.
